name: Veterans Electric LLC
old_description: Veterans Electric is a veteran owned and operated company with eight plus years working in the electrical industry.
about:
Veterans Electric LLC, operating as Veteran's Electric, is based in Lynchburg, Virginia. The company is veteran-owned and operated, founded by Jonathan Maldonado, a master electrician who began his electrical career at age 17 when he joined the military in 2013. Maldonado served a four-year commitment with the Army Corps of Engineers, gaining experience in residential, commercial, and industrial electrical work before establishing the business.

The firm provides electrical contracting services across residential, commercial, and generator installation segments. Residential work includes wiring, lighting upgrades, panel repairs, and smart-home installations. Commercial services cover new installations, system upgrades, and ongoing maintenance for businesses and properties. The company also installs backup generators for homes and businesses. The team reports more than 500 completed projects and offers 24/7 emergency support, with a core crew of four including a lead electrician, technician, operations manager, and installer.

Customers range from homeowners to commercial contractors and property managers. Notable projects include the electrical build-out for the Americas Home Place showroom on Timberlake Road and new-construction wiring for homes on Meadowbrook Lane in Rustburg. The company's background in industrial electrical work also positions it for light industrial clients.

Maldonado emphasizes a personal standard, treating every job as if it were his own house. The company promotes guaranteed quality, skilled professionals, and an experienced team, backed by upfront quotes and a typical scheduling window of 24–48 hours.

name: Viant
old_description: Viant is a medical device contract manufacturer providing end-to-end contract manufacturing for medical devices—from design and development through precision manufacturing, sterile and non-sterile device assembly. OEMs and MedTech startups partner with Viant as a single-source manufacturer of medical devices or engage specific capabilities as needed.
about:
Viant is a medical device contract manufacturer headquartered in Laconia, New Hampshire. The company traces its roots to 1968 when it entered the medical device market with precision metal tubing. Over five decades, it has expanded through acquisitions and organic growth to become a vertically integrated, single-source partner for OEMs and MedTech startups.

Viant provides end-to-end contract manufacturing from design and development through precision manufacturing, sterile and non-sterile device assembly. Its capabilities span precision metal tubing (including nitinol), extrusion, medical-grade plastics and silicone molding, micro-molding, machining, forming, welding, finishing, automated assembly, tooling, and coating. The company operates a global network of facilities with nearly 7,000 employees, offering cleanroom space and factory capacity across multiple continents.

Viant serves OEMs and startups across clinical markets including orthopedics (UHMWPE implants), surgical technology (minimally invasive, robotics, endoscopy), cardiac and interventional (hypotube components, overmolding), drug delivery (auto-injectors, IV sets, respiratory devices), bioprocessing (containment, filtration), bioelectronics (pain management, wearables), diagnostics (chromatography tubing), and respiratory care (masks, tracheal tubes).

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated model, ViaLaunch™ program management, and 1:1 engineering connections as differentiators. Leadership notes that frustration with existing contract manufacturers drove the creation of Viant to provide stronger risk mitigation, process validation, and scalable production volume.

name: Vico Plastics
old_description: We do precision machining of complex shapes for diverse industries including scientific instrumentation, prototyping, and small production runs.
about:
Vico Plastic Molding operates from Janesville, Wisconsin, where it was founded in 2001 by William Gridley. The company began when Gridley, drawing on a background in manufacturing and sales, re‑engineered a struggling marine product into the Boat Vent II, which became a OEM and aftermarket boat cover.

The shop provides injection molding, CNC machining, vacuum forming, scientific molding and tooling, along with secondary operations such as pad printing, kitting, assembly and finished‑goods packaging. It also offers warehousing, production planning and retail fulfillment through SPS Commerce. The facility handles low‑volume custom parts, small production runs and full‑scale production runs.

Customers span scientific instrumentation, prototyping, marine, medical, government and retail sectors. The marine line serves OEM and aftermarket boat‑cover buyers, while the medical and government work includes precision‑machined components and molded assemblies. Retail clients use the company’s warehousing and small‑order fulfillment services.

Vico emphasizes lean manufacturing standards, digital scanning for rapid tooling, and a planning approach that ties cash‑flow forecasting to production scheduling. Its proprietary product line and focus on unique, effective solutions have driven expansion beyond marine into regulated markets.

name: Victory Foodservice
old_description: Stay updated with new items, specials, recipes, top seasonal picks, and industry trends.
about:
Victory Foodservice operates from the Hunts Point section of the Bronx, New York, where it has served the Greater New York foodservice market since 1985. The company is based in a facility that supports its distribution operations across the region.

The distributor supplies a range of foodservice disposables and nonfood items, including latex and vinyl gloves, bar essentials, and private-label products. It maintains catalogs for nonfoods, bar essentials, and private-label lines, and works with a network of vendor partners to stock exclusive brands. Customers can place orders through an online portal or request quotes directly.

Victory Foodservice sells to restaurants, bars, caterers, and other hospitality businesses throughout the New York metropolitan area. Its product mix focuses on the day-to-day consumables those operations need — gloves, bar supplies, and related nonfood items — rather than equipment or fresh food.

The company emphasizes consistent availability and responsive service, summarized in its long-standing tagline about quality and service. No founding family or specific ownership structure is disclosed on its public pages.

name: Viking Steel Fabricators
old_description: Our fabricators can do just about anything!  We have been providing quality service in Fredericksburg since 1950.
about:
Viking Steel Fabricators began in 1950 as the Fredericksburg Machine Shop in downtown Fredericksburg, Virginia. After moving to its current Airport Avenue location beside the city fairgrounds in the 1970s, the shop was purchased by Clayton Mills from his uncle Mr. Stoner. In 1985 Mills hired Don Breivik to start a steel fabrication division; Breivik bought the business in 1999, renaming it Fredericksburg Machine & Steel and expanding to 13 employees. Ownership passed to Don's sons Luke and Erik in 2016, with Luke becoming sole owner in 2017. The 2019 acquisition of Virginia Architectural Metals added ornamental iron and historic restoration capabilities. The company remains family‑operated, with Luke Breivik as president and multiple relatives on staff.

The firm fabricates and erects structural and miscellaneous steel for commercial, institutional, and residential projects throughout Virginia, Washington, D.C., and Maryland. Services include shop and field welding, plate shearing, plate bending and rolling, pipe threading, plasma cutting, and custom handrails in carbon steel, aluminum, stainless steel, bronze, brass, and wrought iron. Viking also stocks steel shapes, plate, pipe, tubing, bar grating, and expanded metal for sale. A 13‑person crew works from the Airport Avenue facility, handling jobs from ornamental railings to large structural packages.

Completed projects span the Antietam Battlefield Tower (Maryland), the Admiral Club and the Pentagon (D.C. area), Virginia Railway Express stations, the Orange County Public Safety Building, the Eastern Shore Public Library, and a satellite dish mount in Greenland. Customers include general contractors, developers, government agencies, healthcare providers such as Patient First, and retailers like AAA. The historic preservation niche, strengthened by the Virginia Architectural Metals acquisition, targets restoration of landmark structures.

Viking highlights its 70‑plus years in Fredericksburg, mobile welding service, and a full steel inventory as differentiators. The 2019 closure of the machine shop to concentrate solely on fabrication reflects a strategic response to sustained demand for structural and ornamental metalwork, supported by the expertise of former Virginia Architectural Metals owners Mike and Betsy Rodrigue.

name: Viking Technology
old_description: Memory and Storage Solutions Optimized for Military Applications
about:
Viking Technology operates from a technology facility in Costa Mesa, California. The company has been delivering leading-edge design and engineering development in DRAM memory, Flash storage, and micro-packaging technologies for over two decades. No founding year or founders are disclosed in public materials.

The firm designs and manufactures ruggedized memory and storage solutions, including DDR4 multi-chip package modules, 2 TB M.2 PCIe NVMe drives, and persistent memory with integrated supercapacitors. Its capabilities span advanced testing in a clean room environment with 110 GHz validation, conformal coating, anti-sulfur resistor integration, and custom form-factor miniaturization. Production occurs at an ITAR-compliant, AS9100-certified U.S. facility, though headcount and floor space are not published.

Viking serves defense and aerospace programs, including ground, sea, and air platforms, as well as avionics and cockpit instrumentation. It also supplies automotive-grade memory rated for -40 °C to +105 °C, telecommunications infrastructure, and energy subsystem applications. Customers range from military prime contractors to industrial OEMs requiring extended temperature ranges from -55 °C to +125 °C.

The company emphasizes U.S.-based R&D, development, and production, coupled with long-standing strategic partnerships and comprehensive supply-chain management. Security features such as hardware AES 256-bit encryption, NSA 9-12 compliant write protection, and hardware-triggered quick erase are built into its military-optimized products.

name: Vintage Reclaimed Lumber Company
old_description: Since 1999, Vintage Reclaimed Lumber has been Oklahoma’s premier resource for DIYers, builders, and enthusiasts looking to build with one-of-a-kind materials sourced from all over the country. Our wide selection of products includes Boxcar wood, Freightliner wood, Live-edge wood, beams, timbers and old barn wood planks. View our gallery to see more
about:
Vintage Reclaimed Lumber Company was founded in 1999 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The business began with a single storage building filled with wood salvaged from an old barn and has grown into a regional supplier of reclaimed lumber.

The company sources and sells a variety of reclaimed wood products including boxcar flooring from railcars, freightliner trailer flooring, live-edge slabs, beams, timbers, and barn wood planks. It also mills flooring and wall/ceiling products from laminated oak and other hardwoods, offers rough-sawn lumber, and provides finish products such as stains, waxes, and sealers. Inventory spans species like walnut, black oak, cottonwood, red oak, white oak, hemlock, and sycamore. The firm operates a warehouse where customers can select materials in person.

Customers include DIY enthusiasts, builders, tradesmen, architects, interior designers, decorators, and wholesalers across the United States. Affiliated companies—Grain & Grange Furniture Mfg and Old World Iron—extend the offering to custom furniture and decorative ironwork for builders and designers.

The company emphasizes its role in diverting historic lumber from landfills, noting it has sourced reclaimed wood since before the green movement gained popularity. It works with a network of pickers to recover ancillary items such as gears, pulleys, and tools from abandoned structures, incorporating them into furniture and architectural elements.

name: Virginia Electric Supply
old_description: Virginia Electric Supply was founded in 1980 focusing on distributing specialty fasteners to the underground mining market. Throughout the years, we have evolved and now have an extensive offering of electrical, data communications, general maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) and electrical OEM products. Virginia Electric Supply is proud to service a broad range of industries delivering value, service, and results that exceed customer expectations.
about:
Virginia Electric Supply was founded in 1980 in Duffield, Virginia, initially focusing on distributing specialty fasteners to the underground mining market. The company has remained locally owned and operated since its inception.

Over the decades, the distributor expanded its portfolio to include electrical, data communications, maintenance/repair/operating (MRO), and electrical OEM products. Today it operates as a single-source procurement partner, offering coordinated supply of distribution and control equipment, lamps and lighting, ballasts, circuit breakers, fittings, conduit, wire and cable, and industrial supplies. The firm employs 19 full-time distribution professionals with a combined 460 years of industry experience.

Virginia Electric Supply serves commercial, industrial, government, mining, and utility sectors, as well as telecommunications and natural gas extraction markets. Its customer base ranges from manufacturing and process plants to electrical contractors, investor-owned utilities, municipalities, and rural electric cooperatives. The company provides value engineering, sourcing, on-site materials management, design assistance, and project management services tailored to each segment.

A stated differentiator is the ability to locate obsolete or hard-to-find items, leveraging a broad manufacturer network and what it describes as the region’s in-stock inventory. The goal is to partner with customers to keep their operations running safely and efficiently.

name: Virginia Industrial Plastics
old_description: Learn about our tooling, heavy gauge thermoforming and CNC trimming capabilities…
about:
Virginia Industrial Plastics, Inc. (VIP) is a family-run plastic thermoforming and fabrication company based in Elkton, Virginia. For over 40 years it has provided contract manufacturing services from its plant there, producing made-in-the-USA parts for a range of industrial and commercial customers.

The company specializes in heavy-gauge thermoforming and vacuum forming, complemented by CNC trimming and CNC cutting from sheet stock. It builds its own tooling, molds, and fixtures, and offers value-added assembly, just-in-time inventory management, product design support, and material specification guidance. VIP also provides turnkey services that cover the full cycle from tooling through assembly, packaging, and shipping.

VIP serves markets including medical, commercial, transportation, construction, industrial, heavy equipment, and government sectors. Its parts are used in shipping containers for refrigerated food, construction equipment components, consumer products, home protection items, transportation parts, and various industrial applications.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality system, a culture of low defects, and a sustainability program that recycles 100 percent of its plastic waste. VIP positions itself as a long-term partner that works with customers to optimize design, material selection, and process to reduce cost and lead time.
